name: crew
description: Subagent panel for Claude Code: one card per agent with a pixel-art mascot, model, effort, context and time

autoOpen.title: Open on first subagent
autoOpen.description: Open the Crew pane the first time a subagent starts in a session. /crew opens and closes it by hand either way.

contextWindow.title: Context window (tokens)
contextWindow.description: Size the ctx percentage is measured against. The engine does not say a subagent's window, so this is an assumption.

maxCards.title: Most cards kept
maxCards.description: How many cards the pane keeps. Past it the oldest finished ones go; a running one never does, so it is a soft limit.

compactFinished.title: Compact finished cards
compactFinished.description: Show a finished agent in two lines with no mascot, so a long list stays readable. Running agents keep the full card.

groupByParent.title: Group by parent agent
groupByParent.description: Show an agent under the agent that spawned it, indented. Only matters when subagents start subagents.

prices.title: Model prices (JSON)
prices.description: USD per million tokens, by model name, to show an estimated cost, for example {"sonnet-5-5": {"in": 3, "out": 15, "cacheR": 0.3, "cacheW": 3.75}}. A cache read price left out is taken as the input price, a cache write price as 1.25 times it. No prices are built in: a model not listed shows no cost.
